EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Today is the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Most of the
time my net stays empty,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but today
I'm determined to catch a big one!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}L'insectosafari a lieu aujourd'hui !
{{TAG:0007:0001:}}Cette année, je suis bien décidée
à remplir mon filet à ras-bord !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bugün {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} var!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Çoğu zaman
ağım boş kalıyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama bugün büyük
bir tane yakalamaya kararlıyım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}It's finally time for the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm
not the best at catching bugs,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but
that won't stop me from trying!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}¡Por fin ha llegado el día de la
Caza de Bichos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}A mí no se me da muy bien,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} pero
me esforzaré todo lo posible para
hacer un buen papel, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}L'insectosafari commence enfin !
Les insectes n'ont qu'à bien se
tenir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Sta per cominciare l'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insettomania{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Anche se tale attività non rientra
fra le mie prerogative,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} m'impegnerò
al massimo per vincere!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aren't you looking forward to the
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I hope I catch one of the
ones I've been reading about!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿No estás deseando que empiece
la Caza de Bichos?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡Espero pillar algún bichito especial
como los que salen en mis libros!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ça fait si longtemps que j'attends
l'insectosafari ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Voilà des mois que
je me documente sur les insectes !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insettomania{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sta per cominciare!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Mi auguro di poter esaminare
dal vivo qualcuno degli esemplari
che ho studiato sulle enciclopedie.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Freust du dich auch auf das
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hoffentlich fang
ich ein interessantes Exemplar!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nı dört gözle beklemiyor
musun?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kitaplarda okuduğum türlerden
birini yakalayabilsem keşke!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}I wonder how the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}will go
today.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}} I'm looking forward to
meeting all kinds of neat bugs!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Qu'est-ce que l'insectosafari nous
réserve ? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}J'espère découvrir des
insectes que je ne connaissais pas !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Bugünkü {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nasıl geçecek
acaba.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}} Bir sürü ilginç böcekle tanışmayı
dört gözle bekliyorum!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Vivaaa! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡La Caza de Bichos ya
ha empezado! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tenía los chakras
que me temblaban de la emoción.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Hurra,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hat
angefangen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mein Kescher ist intakt,
von mir aus kann es losgehen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yaşasın!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}başladı!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ağımda
delik var mı diye baktım; hazırım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I've got my game face on today!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm
determined to net the biggest bug!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Yo también puedo ser competitiva!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Pienso atrapar el bicho más grande
que se haya visto en {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Tremblez, insectes, je suis d'humeur
à en découdre !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} À moi les plus
grosses proies !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Oggi sono più determinata che mai!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mostrerò a tout le monde quale
sublime insetto saprò catturare!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Bugün tam yarışma havasındayım!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} En büyük
böceği ağıma düşürmeye kararlıyım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I think the key to winning this
competition is catching as many
bugs as you can in the first hour!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Creo que la clave para ganar es
atrapar la mayor cantidad de bichos
que puedas durante la primera hora.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Lors d'un insectosafari, tout se joue
pendant la première heure ! Il faut
partir sur les chapeaux de roue !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}A mio parere, il segreto per la
vittoria risiede nel catturare quanti
più insetti possibile nella prima ora!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich glaube, man kann am ehesten
gewinnen, wenn man in der ersten
Stunde viele Krabbeltiere erwischt.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bence bu yarışmayı kazanmanın sırrı, ilk
bir saatte olabildiğince
çok böcek yakalamak!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Where,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} oh, where{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} are my little buggy
friends?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} I'd be much obliged if they
would come out of hiding for me.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Petits, petits, petits...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Par ici les
insectes ! {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sortez de votre cachette,
mes mignons !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dove sono?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Dove sono{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} i miei
piccoli amici invertebrati?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Sarei molto lieta se uscissero
dai loro nascondigli.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Neredesiniz,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} neredesiniz{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} minik böcek
dostlarım?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Saklandığınız yerden benim
için çıksanız çok sevinirim.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The weather sure is great today for 
catching bugs!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Just be sure to sneak
up on them from downwind,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} right?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Cómo me alegro de que haga un
buen día para salir a cazar bichos!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}El truco para pillarlos es acercarte
siguiendo la dirección del viento.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}je. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Supongo que ya lo sabías.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il fait un temps parfait pour un
insectosafari ou je ne m'y connais
pas !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Surtout, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}assure-toi d'être toujours
face au vent quand tu te jettes sur
ta proie !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oggi è davvero il tempo ideale per
catturare gli insetti!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Diamoci da
fare e riempiamo i nostri retini!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wir haben perfektes Wetter zum
Insektenfangen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Man muss sich nur
aus dem Windschatten anschleichen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün böcek yakalamak için hava
gerçekten harika!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yalnız rüzgârı arkana
alıp sessizce yaklaşmak lazım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} değil mi?

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu as fait bonne chasse jusqu'à
présent ?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}} Moi, j'ai beau agiter mon
filet, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}je ne capture que du vent...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Come procede la caccia?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}} Io faccio
roteare il mio retino più che posso,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ma non sto avendo molta fortuna.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hast du schon was gefangen?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Ich schwinge meinen Kescher wie
verrückt, aber bisher hab ich
leider hauptsächlich Gras erwischt.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hiç böcek yakaladın mı?{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}} Ben ağı epey
salladım,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama çoğunlukla
çimen yakalıyorum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}This morning{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} I read a book on the
habitats of different insect species.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
I wanted to catch one of everything.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}But I guess theory and practice are
two different things.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Esta mañana me he leído un libro
sobre las características de los
insectos de esta zona.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Pensaba que me vendría bien para
atraparlos, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}pero{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. no hay manera.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Je suis fin prête :{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ce matin, j'ai
révisé une dernière fois mes notes
sur la capture des insectes.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}En même temps,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} entre la théorie et
la pratique, il y a un monde.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Heute Morgen habe ich noch einmal
mein Insektenbuch durchgeblättert.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
Insekten sind wirklich interessant.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Aber ich merke gerade, dass es
einfacher ist, sie im Buch anzusehen,
als sie im Freien zu erwischen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Bu sabah{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} farklı böcek türlerinin yaşam
alanlarını anlatan bir kitap okudum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Her
türden bir tane yakalamak istiyordum.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ama teoriyle pratik gerçekten başka şeylermiş.

ES:
Ya falta poco para que se acabe
la Caza de Bichos, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}¡así que mucho
ánimo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Puede que en esta competición
seamos rivales, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡pero yo siempre
animo a mis amigos!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}L'Insettomania volge ormai
al termine. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Un ultimo sforzo,
coraggio!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Anche se durante la competizione
siamo rivali,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} in qualità di tua amica
non posso non fare il tifo per te!
DE:
Bald ist das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
vorbei, {{TAG:0003:001F:}}also streng dich noch
etwas an!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wir wollen zwar beide gewinnen,
aber ich unterstütze meine Freunde
natürlich trotzdem!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nın bitmesine pek vakit
kalmadı, o yüzden{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:001F:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} elinden geleni
yap!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bu turnuvada rakip olabiliriz,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
ama dostlarımı her zaman desteklerim!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}What am I going to do?!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} will be over soon!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}I need to find the perfect bug!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}I'm
going to end this tournament with
my net held high.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡¿Y ahora qué voy a hacer?!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡La Caza de Bichos está a punto
de acabarse!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Quiero encontrar al bicho perfecto!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Pienso acabar este torneo con
la red bien alta!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh non !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} L'insectosafari est presque
terminé ! Et moi qui n'ai toujours
pas capturé l'insecte parfait !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais pas question de baisser les
bras :{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je tiens à sortir de ce tournoi
la tête haute !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh, che guaio!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Manca pochissimo
al termine di Insettomania!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}La vera sfida inizia ora!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Terminerò la competizione con il
retino colmo di magnifici esemplari!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Oh nein!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Bald ist das
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} vorbei!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ich muss noch den perfekten Käfer
finden!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Ich will dieses Turnier
erhobenen Keschers beenden!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}This {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}has been fun,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but it's
almost over!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} I need to check all the
trees one last time!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡No quiero que se acabe aún
la Caza de Bichos! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Me lo estoy
pasando muy bien!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0016:}}Ay, a ver si me da tiempo a mirar
en los árboles, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}por si hay algún
escarabajito de última hora.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Je me suis bien amusée, mais
l'insectosafari touche déjà à sa fin...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Allez, je fais une dernière fois le
tour des arbres.{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Peut-être que j'en
dénicherai encore quelques-uns !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}L'Insettomania è così avvincente!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Peccato che sia quasi finita.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Su, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}non
pensiamoci e continuiamo la caccia!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Dieses {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hat mir
großen Spaß gemacht, aber bald ist
es schon wieder vorbei.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Am besten, ich schaue so kurz vor
Schluss noch mal, ob in den Bäumen
irgendwelche Insekten sitzen.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Well,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} the tournament is over.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Now
we wait for the awards ceremony!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pues ya se acabó la competición.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Pero aún falta la ceremonia
de entrega de premios!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ça y est, le tournoi est terminé.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} La
remise des prix ne va pas tarder !
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pekâlâ,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} turnuva bitti.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Şimdi ödül
törenini bekleyeceğiz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I can't wait to hear the final results
of the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} tournament!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Qué ganas tengo de saber los
resultados de la Caza de Bichos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Qui va remporter l'insectosafari
cette fois ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Quel suspense
insoutenable !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich bin schon gespannt auf die
Ergebnisse des {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turniers{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}nın kesin sonuçlarını
duymak için sabırsızlanıyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}tournament was a
success!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The awards ceremony
should be fun no matter who wins.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡La Caza de Bichos ha sido todo
un éxito!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Seguro que la entrega de
premios también será increíble.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cet insectosafari restera dans les
annales !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Peu importe le vainqueur, la remise
des prix s'annonce grandiose !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La gara di Insettomania è stata
un successone!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} Ora, se sapessi che
ho conseguito un buon risultato{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}. sarei ancora più contenta!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ma l'importante è godersi
la cerimonia di premiazione!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} war ein
voller Erfolg!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Bestimmt wird die Preisverleihung
auch schön, ganz egal, wer von uns
gewonnen hat.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Felicidades por el premio,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Cómo has conseguido
ser tan buen{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} cazando bichitos?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Me encantaría que me dieras algún
consejo para cuando se organice
otra competición, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Félicitations, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Où as-tu
appris à capturer les insectes
comme ça ?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Si tu cherches une disciple à qui
enseigner ton art,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} je me porte
volontaire !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Glückwunsch, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Wieso bist du eigentlich so
gut im Insektenfangen?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn du irgendwelche guten Tipps
hast, kannst du sie mir ja vor dem
nächsten Turnier sagen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ödülün için tebrikler,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Böcek
yakalamada nasıl{{TAG:0003:0017:}} bu kadar iyi oldun?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Güzel tüyoların varsa{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bir sonraki
turnuvadan önce benimle de paylaşır
mısın, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}You're just amazing at catching
bugs,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I knew you'd
finish in the top three!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}¡Eres increíble, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
Sabía que acabarías entre los tres
primeros. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Todo se te da bien!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}La capture d'insectes n'a aucun
secret pour toi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! J'étais
sûre que tu serais bien classé{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}La tua abilità nel catturare insetti
è très incroyable,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sapevo che avrei letto il tuo nome
nella classifica dei migliori tre.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Questa sera dobbiamo festeggiare!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Félicitations ! {{TAG:0007:0001:}}Ça a l'air tellement
facile pour toi ! Tu dois avoir un
don,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Herzlichen Glückwunsch!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Du hast
so viel Talent, da ist es dir sicher
ganz leichtgefallen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ödülün için tebrikler!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Senin gibi doğal
yeteneği olan biri için neredeyse kolay
gelmiştir, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I guess luck was on my side today!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}I mean,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I never imagined I would do
better than you, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}I guess all that research and time
spent practicing really paid off!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hoy me ha sonreído la suerte!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Vamos,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} jamás pensé que llegaría
a hacerlo mejor que tú, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}¡Supongo que tanto mi investigación
como las horas de práctica han
dado sus frutos!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La chance était de mon côté
aujourd'hui ! {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Jamais je n'aurais
pensé battre {{TAG:000E:0006:10006C00650020006700720061006E00640012006C00610020006700720061006E0064006500}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Toutes ces heures d'étude et de
documentation n'auront pas été
vaines, en fin de compte !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La dea bendata oggi mi ha sorriso!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Voglio dire,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} mai avrei immaginato
di riuscire a superarti, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}A quanto pare, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}tutte quelle ore
spese ad allenarmi tra enciclopedie
e retini hanno dato i loro frutti!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich schätze, ich hatte wohl einfach
nur Glück!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:001A:}} Ich hätte nie gedacht,
dass ich gegen dich gewinne!
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Allerdings habe ich auch sehr viel
recherchiert und geübt, das hat
sich offenbar gelohnt!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugün şans benden yanaydı galiba!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:001A:}}Yani,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} senden daha iyi derece yapacağım
aklımın ucundan geçmezdi, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Demek yaptığım araştırmalar ve onca
pratik gerçekten işe yaramış!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I've improved a lot at catching bugs!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}But I shouldn't get overconfident,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} or
next time I might not win an award.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es increíble lo que he mejorado
cazando bichos, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡pero todavía
me queda mucho por aprender!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je me suis drôlement améliorée en
capture d'insectes !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mais je ne dois
pas me reposer sur mes lauriers...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non c'è dubbio, la mia abilità
nel catturare insetti è notevolmente
migliorata. Je suis fantastique!
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Tuttavia, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}non è questo il momento
di cullarsi sugli allori,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} o rischio di
non vincere nulla la prossima volta.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich bin im Insektenfangen viel besser
geworden! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Aber ich sollte mich nicht
auf meinen Lorbeeren ausruhen...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Böcek yakalamada çok ilerledim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ama
kendime fazla güvenmemeliyim,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} yoksa
bir dahaki sefere ödül alamayabilirim.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Lo he conseguido!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} He concentrado
mi energía en un objetivo y me he
esforzado mucho{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. 
¡Ha merecido la pena, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'ai réussi ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Je n'ai pas ménagé mes
efforts et je suis restée concentrée
sur l'objectif.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Youpi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ich hab's geschafft!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Alles durch
Konzentration und harte Arbeit,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Oh, ich freue mich!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Başardım!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Hedefime odaklanıp bütün gün
çok çalıştım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Çok mutluyum,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I'm really surprised you didn't
get an award,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} I wonder
if a bug chewed through your net.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿Oh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Me sorprende mucho que no
te hayas llevado ningún premio,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¿Será que tu red no es apropiada
y que por eso se te escapan
los mejores bichos?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Mais...? Comment les prix ont-il pu
t'échapper, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}} ? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ça doit
être ton filet qui a fait son temps...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Oh?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Stento quasi a credere
che tu non sia riuscit{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}
a classificarti,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mi chiedo se per caso un insetto
dispettoso non ti abbia
rosicchiato il retino{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.?!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Was?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du hast gar nichts gewonnen,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} Vielleicht war dein
Kescher irgendwie kaputt?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hmm{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}If you'd asked me before
the tournament,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'd have said you
were sure to finish in the top three.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}But I suppose stranger things have
happened.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Don't take it too hard!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmm{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Estaba convencidísima
de que acabarías entre los tres
primeros.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Pero bueno, cosas más raras se
han visto. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡No te lo tomes a mal!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hum{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'aurais mis ma main à
couper que tu finirais dans les
trois premiers...
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Enfin, c'est la dure loi du sport !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Ne
le prends pas trop à cœur...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mmmh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Se me l'avessero chiesto
prima della gara,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} avrei dato per
certa la tua presenza in classifica.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Tuttavia, qualche volta accade
l'impensabile.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Non ti crucciare,
sarà per la prossima volta!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hmmm...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Wenn du mich vor dem
Turnier gefragt hättest, hätte ich
gesagt, dass du sicher gewinnst.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Aber egal, jeder kann mal einen
schlechten Tag haben.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Nimm es
dir nicht zu sehr zu Herzen!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Did you have fun at the tournament
today?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Having a good time is the
most important thing, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¿Te lo has pasado bien hoy?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Espero que sí, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡porque ese es el
objetivo real de todo esto!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu t'es bien amusé{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ?
L'important, dans un tournoi, c'est
de prendre du plaisir !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Com'è andata la competizione?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}La cosa più importante è che
tu ti sia divertit{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Hat dir das Turnier Spaß gemacht,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Mitmachen ist ja viel
wichtiger als gewinnen...
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugünkü turnuvada eğlendin mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
En önemlisi keyif almak, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}It's too bad you didn't make it to
the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}awards ceremony.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I
was looking forward to seeing you.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Qué lástima que no hayas ido a
la entrega de premios, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Esperaba verte por allí!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}È un vero peccato che tu
non abbia potuto partecipare
alla cerimonia di premiazione.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Avrei tanto voluto che ci fossi,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}ma posso capire che tu
avessi altre faccende a cui badare.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ödül törenine gelememene
üzüldüm.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Seni orada görmeyi bekliyordum.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Why didn't you attend the awards
ceremony for the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} I missed
seeing you there, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}¿Por qué no has ido a la ceremonia
de entrega de premios? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Se te
echaba de menos,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Pourquoi tu n'es pas ven{{TAG:000E:0006:02007500040075006500}} à la
remise des prix ? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Je me réjouissais
tellement de te voir, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Pourquoi non sei venut{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} alla
cerimonia di premiazione?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Avrei
tanto voluto vederti, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Warum warst du denn nicht bei der
Preisverleihung vom {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-
Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Wir haben dich vermisst!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ödül törenine niye
katılmadın?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Seni orada göremeyince
eksikliğini hissettim, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Starting tomorrow,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'm going to try
catching 10 bugs a day.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I have to
keep my skills sharp!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A partir de mañana, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}saldré a cazar
bichos todos los días. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Así mejoraré
para la próxima competición!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ab morgen werde ich jeden Tag
zehn Insekten fangen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich muss
nämlich fit bleiben!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yarından itibaren{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} günde 10 böcek
yakalamaya çalışacağım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Formumu
korumam lazım!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Today's {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bug-Off {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}has furthered my
interest in entomology.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} That's the
study of insects,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you know.
In fact,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} when I get home,{{TAG:0003:0026:}} I think I'll
crack open my encyclopedia!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Con la Caza de Bichos, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}me han dado
ganas de estudiar entomología!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡En cuanto llegue a casa, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}voy a
coger mi enciclopedia de bichos!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Hay mucho que aprender!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je suis plus passionnée que jamais
par l'entomologie maintenant ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Tu
sais, l'étude des insectes.
Je vais me jeter sur l'encyclopédie{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
dès que je rentre chez moi !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La competizione di quest'oggi
ha risvegliato il mio interesse
per l'entomologia!
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Infatti{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} non vedo l'ora di tornare
a casa{{TAG:0003:0026:}} e tuffarmi tra le enciclopedie
alla ricerca di insetti sempre nuovi!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Das heutige {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Insektikus-Turnier{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} hat
mein Interesse an der Entomologie
erneut geweckt.
Das ist Insektenkunde, wie du sicher
weißt.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}} Wenn ich heimgehe, lese ich
in meiner Käferenzyklopädie weiter!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bugünkü {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}entomolojiye
olan ilgimi daha da artırdı.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yani böcek
bilimine,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} biliyorsun.
Hatta{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} eve varınca{{TAG:0003:0026:}} ansiklopedimi açıp
biraz okuyacağım!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Qué penita que la ceremonia de la
Caza de Bichos se haya cancelado.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Quería felicitar a todo el mundo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Quelle guigne que la remise des prix
de l'insectosafari soit annulée ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Moi
qui voulais féliciter tout le monde !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Mi dispiace molto che la cerimonia
di premiazione sia stata cancellata.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Volevo congratularmi con tutti!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Wie schade, dass die Preisverleihung
ausfallen musste.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich wollte doch
den ganzen Gewinnern gratulieren!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Böcek Turnuvası{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} ödül töreninin iptal
edilmesine üzüldüm.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Herkesi tebrik
etmek istiyordum!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Quel dommage ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}La remise des prix
a été annulée... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Espérons que ça ne
devienne pas une habitude !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Die Preisverleihung ist abgesagt
worden.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wie schade.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Hoffentlich
gibt es nächstes Mal wieder eine!
